name: m1-object-location-coverage-exit-audit
scope: Independently verify the seven M1 search locator families through the shared managed-object navigation contract.
Independently verify the seven selected bounded graph object families from Graph and relation context.
Preserve search return state, Graph return context, stable same-source identities, mention-free structural relations and source immutability.
Keep ordinary DOCX blocks and ODS cells as search objects rather than graph objects.

corrections.expected: Reuse the six search regressions from M4A-1 as the M1 exit set.
corrections.actual: Workbook sheet search was selected and verified in M4A-2 but was not part of the earlier six-result M4A-1 regression set.
corrections.resolution: M4A-6 uses a seven-family search matrix and includes workbook-sheet explicitly.

corrections.expected: The audit can request a second rebuild immediately after the Library shell appears.
corrections.actual: Library startup already prepares a missing index asynchronously, so an immediate duplicate rebuild is rejected while the first build is active.
corrections.resolution: Wait for the automatic schema-v2 index to reach ready, then read its status before exercising search.

corrections.expected: A relation-context readiness gate can depend on exact display-title equality for every producer format.
corrections.actual: The contract is the file/internal scope and focused locator; producer-derived presentation titles are display data and are not a stable readiness signal.
corrections.resolution: Gate context readiness on the expected scope and independently verify the visible internal target and route.

corrections.expected: Opening a PPTX parent node after a slide node resets relation context to the file.
corrections.actual: PptxReaderView unconditionally synchronized the active slide during load, recreating internal focus even when the route carried no slide locator; the backend correctly returned the parent when invoked without focus.
corrections.resolution: Only synchronize slide focus for an explicit route locator or user slide selection, and clear focus when the PPTX route has no internal locator.

corrections.expected: All historical M4A selection checks remain valid after their approved successors are implemented.
corrections.actual: The M4A-2 checker still required ODP and Workbook graph dispatch and semantics to remain absent, while the M4A-3 successor is already accepted.
corrections.resolution: Preserve the original zero-node evidence and validate the approved M4A-2 to M4A-3 implementation chain against current code.

deferred: DOCX paragraph, list-item, table, image, page-break and related-content graph nodes.
Workspace actions until a separate bounded selection audit.
Unified conversion disclosure and new conversion types.

selectedNextStage.name: workspace-object-action-selection-audit
